title: Foodtech: Trotz Scheitern von Infarm – Vertical Farming meldet sich zurück
description: Despite the failure of Infarm, vertical farming is making a comeback. Swedish provider Swegreen and Veganz founder Jan Bredack continue working on the vertical future of food production with OrbiFarm.

title: Jan Bredack to Step Down as Veganz CEO, Will Be Succeeded by Financial Expert Rayan Tegtmeier
description: Veganz founder Jan Bredack steps down as CEO effective October 1, 2025 to become Managing Director of OrbiFarm GmbH, the indoor farming subsidiary sold earlier for €30 million.

title: Veganz Group's Jan Bredack steps down as CEO of loss-making business
description: Jan Bredack steps down as Veganz CEO to focus on indoor farming as Managing Director of OrbiFarm, the vertical farming business sold for €30m to an unidentified third party.

title: Veganz Group spins-off Mililk unit as €30m realised from Orbifarm sale
description: Veganz Group sells 100% of OrbiFarm GmbH for €30 million plus profit share and spins off Mililk FoodTech as part of a major corporate restructuring.

title: Veganz Eyes Turnaround with Launch of Mililk FoodTech & $35M Sale of OrbiFarm
description: Following three years of revenue decline, Veganz Group eyes a turnaround by selling OrbiFarm for €30M ($35M) and launching Mililk FoodTech as a new subsidiary.

title: Veganz verkauft OrbiFarm für 30 Millionen Euro
description: Veganz sells its indoor farming subsidiary OrbiFarm for 30 million euros. The Veganz share gains about 4 percent following the announcement.

title: World premiere: Körber Technologies and Veganz Group present Orbifarm® technology at GreenTech Amsterdam
description: Körber Technologies and Veganz Group present the OrbiFarm® vertical farming technology at GreenTech Amsterdam, marking its world premiere with VR experience at the trade show.

title: Grows even in the desert
description: Deutsche Bank profiles Jan Bredack and OrbiFarm's vision to produce plant-based proteins industrially anywhere in the world, even in deserts, using vertical indoor farming technology.

title: Berlin start-up OrbiFarm is revolutionising the production of plant-based proteins with indoor farming
description: OrbiFarm achieves yields up to 36 times higher than traditional agriculture using indoor farming, without soil, weather dependency or long transport routes.

title: From pea to active pharmaceutical ingredient: OrbiFarm revolutionizes global food and drug production
description: Veganz Group founds OrbiFarm GmbH with a €40 million valuation, focusing on industrial-scale cultivation of protein plants and medicinal plants including peas, quinoa, hemp, and tobacco for insulin production.

title: Veganz Group AG establishes OrbiFarm GmbH ahead of strategic investor entry
description: Veganz Group AG founds OrbiFarm GmbH on April 10, 2025 to centralize indoor farming patents, licenses and branding, with a €10 million strategic investor entry expected in Q2/2025.

title: Veganz Unveils Game-Changing OrbiFarm Technology for Supercharged Pea Protein Farming
description: Veganz and Körber Technologies launch OrbiFarm technology enabling pea plants to yield twice the produce and be harvested six times a year under controlled indoor conditions.

title: Veganz Group AG and Körber Technologies GmbH Partner on OrbiFarm® Technology
description: Veganz Group formalizes partnership with Körber Technologies for the design, manufacture and distribution of the patented OrbiFarm® indoor farming technology.

title: Indoor farming technology from Körber promises sustainable protein source
description: Körber Technologies signs contract with Veganz for design, manufacture and distribution of OrbiFarm technology, bringing Fraunhofer-developed indoor farming systems to industrial-scale production.

title: Veganz Group AG and VeGreat LLC to Launch Vertical Farming Project for Protein Crops in Dubai
description: Veganz Group AG and US-based VeGreat LLC announce OrbiFarm as a joint venture to exploit vertical farming technologies for protein crops in Dubai, UAE.

title: Veganz-Gründer Jan Bredack: Vom Vegan-Händler zum Vertical-Farmer
description: Handelsblatt profiles Jan Bredack's transformation from vegan retailer to vertical farmer, detailing how Veganz plans to produce 1,000 tons of pea protein with just five people using indoor farming.

title: Veganz Secures Worldwide Licensing Rights for OrbiPlant® and OrbiLoop® Vertical Farming Platform Technology
description: Veganz Group AG secures exclusive worldwide licensing rights for the OrbiPlant® and OrbiLoop® vertical farming platform technology from the Fraunhofer Institute IME.

title: Veganz relies on Fraunhofer indoor farming system
description: Veganz secures licensing rights to the OrbiPlant vertical farming technology from Fraunhofer IME, enabling efficient large-scale production of plant-based foods using a wave-shaped conveyor system.
